title: Fresh Mc
description: This project is a fresh alternative of normal minecraft. The goal is to be the smoothest modpack of all time
body:
🌿✨ Fresh MC ✨🌿
🌍 Vanilla+ Done Right

Fresh MC is a lightweight, immersive modpack that enhances Minecraft without changing its core feel.
Smooth gameplay, better visuals, and subtle details — all while staying true to vanilla.

🔥 Features
🌍 Immersion

🌊 Water feels more alive and reactive
❄️ Environment adapts with subtle seasonal visuals
✨ Small details that make a big difference

🎨 Visuals

🌟 Cleaner, richer particles and effects
🧥 Smooth character animations
🌿 A more polished and modern look

🔊 Audio

🎧 Dynamic, immersive sound experience
🔊 Sounds behave naturally based on surroundings

⚙️ Quality of Life

🔍 Smooth zoom functionality
📊 Built-in performance tools
⚡ Clean and responsive gameplay

⚡ Performance

💻 Designed for low to mid-end PCs
🚀 Optimized for smooth FPS
🧼 No unnecessary bloat

🎯 Philosophy

✔️ Stay true to vanilla
✔️ Enhance, don’t replace
✔️ Clean and simple
✔️ Performance first

🎮 Perfect For

🟩 Vanilla+ players
💻 Lower-end setups
✨ Players who want a fresh, modern Minecraft feel

📦 Notes

⚠️ Client-side focused experience
⚠️ Works great in singleplayer & multiplayer
⚠️ Clean and minimal setup
